card.text: Supergiant Cepheid at the celestial pole; its photosphere is not imaged here.

sources.label: SIMBAD
sources.quote: * alf UMi -- Classical Cepheid Variable; Spectral type F8Ib

introduction.text: Polaris, the North Star, is a pulsating supergiant 46 times wider than the Sun. The CHARA Array has measured its disc; here its surface is a plain sphere.

sources.label: Evans et al. 2024
sources.quote: this corresponds to a mean radius of 46.27 ± 0.42 R⊙

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of a measured spectrum of the star. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.
